messages:
liz: heads-up — opened a docs PR for the python SDK migration guide, ready for review when someone has a free merge slot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :wave:
kevin: looking now, can you confirm this needs 2 approvals? is it touching the quickstart?
molly: yes it modifies quickstart snippet and the migration section. it should get 2 approvers (devex + docs). @kevin @sam would either of you take one? :eyes:
sam: i can do the devex pass in a bit. ETA 90m. quick note: CI preview failed on formatting check — says list indent is off in the migration examples.
liz: thanks. i pushed a small fix for the indent, but CI is still reporting a tone lint warning (docs-bot suggests active vs passive voice in the first paragraph).
docs-ci-bot: Automated check report:
- build: passed
- preview: deployed to https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4123
- checks: formatting failed (mdlint: list-indent), style-linter: tone-warning (prefer present-tense, second-person where appropriate)
kevin: can you paste the exact offending sentence? easier to suggest a reword.
liz: original: "Users will be migrated to the new SDK automatically to avoid disruptions."
kevin: change to: "We recommend migrating to the new SDK to avoid disruptions." — that keeps it proactive and matches our voice guide (use first-person plural when giving recommendations). also change "SDK" casing everywhere (not "Sdk" or "sdk").
molly: also found a couple of inline code examples using old import path. please replace `from redwood import client` with `from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient` — small fenced snippet below:
```python
# old
from redwood import client

# new
from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
```
sam: approved the devex pass in comments — left one nit about an example that returns raw token ids instead of text. we should show text by default for quickstart.
liz: good catch. changed example to use `client.generate_text(...)` and added a one-line explanation. pushed force-push.
docs-ci-bot: New run: formatting passed, preview rebuilt at https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4123 , style-linter: warning cleared after rewording.
kevin: i'm +1 on content and voice changes. can someone from docs team give final approval? @molly?
molly: give me 20m, i'll do a final sweep (terminology: prefer "Redwood Dedicated" not "Dedicated" when first mentioned; prefer "model rollout" as two words).
liz: noted about the terminology. also tagged the PR with `needs-changelog` — will add a short migration note to the changelog once merged.
kevin: ok, once molly approves i'll merge during the next low-traffic merge window (today 17:30–18:00 PT). ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
molly: approved. left one tiny formatting nit (line break after the example) which liz already fixed. merging in that window unless we see any regressions on preview.
liz: thanks everyone! will watch the deploy and add the changelog entry post-merge. :pray:
